The '''''Bognog''''' was a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]] that was owned and operated by the [[Nami]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Nami had reemerged from their exile in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] as a new ally of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and intended to use their new fleet to wage war against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During this campaign, the ''Bognog'' attacked an Imperial docking facility stationed in the [[Yrrna system/Legends|Yrrna system]] with its newly commissioned wing of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]], after having stolen its technology in an earlier raid against the Empire. The Nami intended to demonstrate the starfighter's technological superiority to the Rebels with the hopes of eventually selling the technology to the Alliance. The ''Bognog'' carried out its assault with Rebels aboard the [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] [[Jester (Carrack-class)|''Jester'']] acting as observers.

The base's docking crew immediately fled on the [[Modular conveyor]] ''[[Ulzepdi]]'' and sent a distress signal out to allied forces, prompting a responsive strike led by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] in hopes of saving the crew. The ''Bognog'' responded by sending out several wings of [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wings]] and [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|''Delta''-class DX-9 stormtrooper transports]] to destroy the ''Ulzepdi'' and its escorts before it could escape. However, Stele and his wingman diverted its fighter wings long enough for the ''Ulzepdi'' to flee into hyperspace. However, the attack was a success as the ''Bognog'' and its wing of TIE Defenders proceeded to wipe out the entire staging area, much to the amazement of its hopeful Rebel buyers.
